document_title: Modernization Brief - MagicBox Modernization Executive Brief
scope_summary: The current BRD is grounded in 565,185 LOC across 3,827 files from the selected PHP scope. Unless the scope lock explicitly states full-repository coverage, this document should not be interpreted as claiming that every legacy workflow was analyzed.
current_state_summary: Legacy PHP custom_php_mvc application with 785 routes, 249 controllers, 372 analyzed model files, 1684 templates/views, 3836 extracted SQL statements, and 4 detected background job workflows.
target_state_summary: Deliver a modern target architecture (TBD — ratify SYN-HLD-004 before Architect stage) with explicit services, route handling, and hardened security/data access behavior.
blocking_decisions: DEC-SESSION-001: Session behavior must be mapped to the target authentication/session model.
DEC-SESSION-COUNTRY-001: COUNTRY_ALLOWED session behavior must be preserved or intentionally redesigned because it affects regional access control.
DEC-BDD-001 resolution plan: capture golden flows for the onboarding, contractor placement, and portal upload workflows before sprint planning is approved.
DEC-FILEIO-001: Upload and export workflows require target-state storage and validation design.
DEC-INTEGRATION-GP-001: Preserve or redesign GP import flows (GP/import.php, GP/import_emp_vendor.php).
DEC-INTEGRATION-SP-001: Confirm SharePoint Online dependency observed through phpSPO paths and define target-state integration ownership.
DEC-DATA-FUNC-001: Reimplement custom MySQL functions recentProfile(), alignRate(), hourGMByProfile() before target-state data access is approved.
DEC-INTEGRATION-FEDERATED_STAFFING-001: Federated Staffing is listed by the owner architecture document and needs explicit modernization ownership and dependency review.
